description: Election Commission - Mr. Soosaipillai Mohanadas Selected as a Member of Kuchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kuchchaveli Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member to fill the vacancy. This content falls squarely within the definition of Elections Gazettes, which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
